105:- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-e
val-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuit
eId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this b
ody is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…
106:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md):
The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups in
stead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.
107:- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its c
ases. Past runs are not deleted.
108:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partia
l update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (rev
erting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated s
uite.
109:- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclos
ure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it calls and where they route,
which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the subprocessors engaged.
Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…
110:- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the
suite, in the public steps-first shape.
111:- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. B
oth `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but
a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.
112:- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 ca
ses to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files wi
thout a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported
individually: a `failed…
113:- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-su
ites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them — t
he only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.
114:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): T
he sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person alrea
dy wrote — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered
steps, tool calls, assertions), so the…
116:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-aut
horing-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or propo
sed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.
117:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite
and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.
118:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the sui
te. Past runs that executed it are not affected.
119:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitted fiel
ds are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks`
accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.
126:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK mod
el leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately — the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases al
so expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must
do.
134:- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-det
erministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60
-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged
draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…
150:- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in
the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends — the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.
170:- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused
while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it — the error names what to detach first. Guest cal
lers are denied (a write).
191:- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only
on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is
bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using
the same locator vocabul…
193:- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One
entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how ma
ny runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snap
